metadata.title: On a family of stably handle-slide trivial R-links
metadata.abstract: An R-link is an n-component link L in S^3 such that Dehn surgery on L yields #^nS1 \times S2. Adapting work of Gompf, Scharlemann and Thompson, Meier and Zupan produced a family of R-links L(p, q; c/d), where the pairs (p, q) and (c, d) are relatively prime and c is even. For most of link in this family, whether it is handle-slide trivial remains open. In this work, we show one subfamily, L(3, 2; 4/d), are stably handle-slide trivial for all d.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 三维链环与稳定柄滑动
analysis.workSummary: R-link 指 n 分支链环在 S³ 中手术后得到 n 个 S¹×S² 的连通和。本文处理 Meier–Zupan 构造的 L(p,q;c/d) 族中的子族 L(3,2;4/d)，证明对族中所有允许的 d 都可在稳定化后经柄滑动化为平凡链环。
analysis.breakthrough: 为既有 R-link 族提供一个整体可控的子族，而该大族多数成员是否无需稳定化即可柄滑动平凡仍未解决。
analysis.limitations: 结论是稳定柄滑动平凡，不等于原链环直接柄滑动平凡；d 仍须满足原族中互素等参数限制，不能把“所有 d”脱离该定义理解。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
